title: Show HN: IKEA Complexity Index
summary: A creative web project that analyzes and ranks IKEA furniture by assembly complexity, providing shoppers with data-driven insights to make more informed purchasing decisions.
problem_solved: Helps IKEA shoppers understand which products are simpler or more complex to assemble before purchasing.
why_valuable: Turns a common pain point (IKEA assembly complexity) into an engaging, searchable index that saves time and frustration for buyers.
